# list { #crossrepo.list }

```python
crossrepo.list(
    repo=None,
    pattern=None,
    *,
    brief=False,
    version=False,
    spec=False,
    url=False,
    refresh=False,
    progress=False,
    cfg=None,
)
```

Tabulate what the configured repositories publish.

The python side of ``crossrepo list``, and like it the version is left out
unless asked for: it is a full commit sha, and every file a repository
publishes carries the same one.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Keep only repositories whose ``owner/repo`` contains this, as ``crossrepo list <repo>`` does.

<code>[**pattern**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Keep only files whose name matches this glob, such as ``"*.csv"``.

<code>[**brief**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show only what a file is and where reading it goes: ``owner``, ``repo``, ``name``, ``description`` and ``get``.

<code>[**version**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Include the ``version`` column, the full commit sha.

<code>[**spec**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Include the ``spec`` column, the one string naming a file at a version, which [](`crossrepo.fetch`) and the command line take. It restates the repository, the path and the version, so it is the widest column there is and is left out unless wanted.

<code>[**url**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Include the ``url`` column, addressing that version on GitHub.

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan before listing, rather than using the stored catalog.

<code>[**progress**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show a progress bar while rescanning. Only meaningful with `refresh`, since a stored catalog is read at once.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.active_config`): what [](`crossrepo.config.use_config`) registered, or the configuration file.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A `Table`, which is a [](`pandas.DataFrame`), with one row per published file or dataset: ``owner``, ``repo``, ``name``, ``description``, ``get``, ``date``, ``github``, ``path``, ``dir``, ``bytes``, ``tags`` and ``lfs``, or the five columns of `brief`, plus whichever of ``version``, ``spec`` and ``url`` were asked for. ``get`` says where reading the file goes: ``local`` for a clone on this machine, ``github`` for a repository read over the API, and the server's name or alias for one reached over ssh. ``github`` is the repository as ``owner/repo``, and ``path`` the file as ``dir/name``. [](`crossrepo.frame`) has everything, including the number of files a dataset holds.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ImportError](`ImportError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If pandas is not installed. It is not a dependency of `crossrepo`.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
import crossrepo

crossrepo.list()                        # everything published
crossrepo.list(brief=True)              # just what each file is, and how big
crossrepo.list("x-gwas")                # one repository
crossrepo.list(pattern="*.parquet")     # by file name
crossrepo.list(version=True)            # with the sha that pins each file
crossrepo.list(spec=True)               # with the string the shell takes
```
